notes:
New in 0.8.4:
- Faster loading: the second start of a game reuses the code translated the first time. Leave games from their own menu or Exit and wait for "Closing the game…".
- Mouse sticks move like a joystick, with a speed setting (Controls tab, or hold the gear › Stick speed).
- The phone's keyboard types into Windows games (back-button menu › Keyboard, gear › Keyboard, or a Keyboard button).
- Rename games in the Library; EdRoid asks for a name when you add one.
- Unity games run faster (Balanced speed instead of Safe), and new smaller screen sizes give more FPS: Library ⋮ › Screen size › Fit my phone, faster.
- EdRoid tells Android it's a game, so the phone's game mode (e.g. ColorOS Game Space) can give it full speed.
